items.label: Functional Design
items.value: This cute purse includes 3 card slot pockets, 1 zipper pouch and main pocket inside, making it spacious enough to organize your essentials

items.label: Premium Material
items.value: Crafted from high-quality PU leather with a soft polyester lining, this women bag offers a comfortable touch. The smooth metal zipper and durable gold hardware enhance its elegance and durability

items.label: Versatile Straps
items.value: Equipped with a removable short leather shoulder strap and a long gold chain strap(as a small gift), this bag can be styled as a shoulder bag, retro handbag, underarm purse, clutch purse, hobo tote, or crossbody bag—perfect for travel, work, dates, parties, or shopping

items.label: Stylish & Practical
items.value: Available in various beautiful colors, this everyday purse complements any outfit and adds a fashionable touch to your daily look

items.label: Ideal Gift Option
items.value: A thoughtful gift for women on birthdays, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, graduations, Christmas, or New Year. Delight your loved ones with a versatile and stylish accessory they’ll treasure

items.label: Pocket Description
items.value: Slit Pocket, Slip Pocket, Zipper Pouch

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Hand wash only. Avoid contact with harsh chemicals. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use.
